reference.question: From the top of a building \(24\text{ m}\) high, the angle of depression to a point \(A\) on the ground is \(\alpha\), with \(\tan\alpha=3/4\). Find the horizontal distance from \(A\) to the base of the building. (Unit: m)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Tangent and a proportion

\(\tan\alpha=\text{building height}/\text{horizontal distance}\), so \(3/4=24/d\) and \(d=32\).
